name: Open WebUI
description: Open WebUI is an OpenSource ChatGPT-style chat interface for running AI models. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Open WebUI as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: Self-hosted ChatGPT-style AI chat interface. Deploy Open WebUI with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
